modifiers.after: Keep authored native inventory/slot art, remove baked controls, correct 25px atlas rows, independent press state, fitted labels and wrapped status; no world launch claimed.

modifiers.before: New transactions set LedgerOnly=true and sellAndCollect immediately collected funds.
modifiers.after: New transactions use existing funded physical issuance journal and leave stamped Coins in 9 payment slots. Existing LedgerOnly transaction recovery remains compatible. Button sells or collects existing payment; normal Escape/inventory close blocked until payment empty.

modifiers.before: Closing could return/stash output and release visitor; owner break allowed; no explicit explosion/fire contract.
modifiers.after: Persist existing seller account and visitor UUID; pending payment/in-flight journal blocks manual acquisition, all player breaks and release. Forced close/death/disconnect retains exclusive session and automatically resumes only authenticated same account near loaded box with default inventory menu. No forced teleports or overrides of another screen. Explosion and mob destruction denied, nonflammable, no fire spread. Piston remains blocked.
